Project Highlights

WHOOP
NetSuite Order Status Reconciliation

Manually reconciled NetSuite sales order data with warehouse shipment reports daily — copying data between systems, clearing duplicates from cancelled orders, and cross-referencing conflicting shipment statuses. Without automated visibility, orders risked falling through the cracks and stakeholders faced delayed answers on order status.

Using Parabola, I automated the daily extraction and reconciliation of NetSuite sales orders against Arvato warehouse email reports. The flow sorts records to capture the latest order instances, removes duplicates, and joins datasets on order number to build a single source of truth — evaluating NetSuite confirmations, tracking numbers, and Arvato updates to definitively determine shipment status. It also segments orders for weekly performance reviews, surfaces VIP and enterprise orders needing attention, and flags orders left open beyond SLA without a valid rejection reason.
